Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for residents, and the registration page is https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026. The general public opens 7 days later, so your residents-first date is the one that counts for you. Max's age is inside the published age band, and Mia's is just outside it, within the margin for an approximate birthday, so check she fits before you sign up.

If you approve, I will text you the week ahead 7 days before, a checklist 3 days before, an evening-before reminder, and a just-before-open text 15 minutes before. I never register for you. Those texts only help you get to the page on time.

Once you have picked a course, send me its link and the morning text will carry it too. Do you approve?
